Blue Letter Bible study tools make reading, searching and studying the Bible easy and rewarding.

passages.title: Moses’ Third Speech: Final Exhortation.
passages.text: These chapters represent the climax of Moses’ preaching. He pleads with Israel to accept the covenant.

notes.text: This verse anticipates that the exiles (29:28) will return to God, or repent. all your heart . . . soul. Compare 30:6, 10. See 6:5 and note.
the Lord . . . will circumcise your heart. See note on 10:16. so that you will love. God’s changing of the heart makes obedience possible (6:5).
The blessings promised in 28:1–14 will now happen.

not too hard. When the heart is circumcised (see note on v. 6), keeping the law is possible. the word . . . is in your mouth and in your heart. This is the result of the changed heart that enables obedience.
I have set before you. See also v. 19. Moses ends his sermon by seeking a commitment from Israel to obey God’s commands.
To choose life is to choose God himself. It is to trust in God’s grace and the changes he makes in a person’s heart. holding fast. See 4:4 and note on 4:3–4.
